description: This file defines the ECUImageFilter class, a Java class that extends javax.swing.filechooser.FileFilter to filter ECU image files with specific extensions (bin, hex) in a graphical user interface context.

classes.name: ECUImageFilter
classes.description: A Java class extending FileFilter to provide filtering for ECU image files based on extension (.bin, .hex) within a GUI file chooser.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether the given file is accepted by this filter, delegating to an internal GenericFileFilter instance.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of files accepted by this filter, delegating to an internal GenericFileFilter instance.
